about.description: DRAM is an ETF perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking Roundhill Memory ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
